shortlist.name: ScrewCount
shortlist.publicMetadataAccess: Anonymous HF API200; data/annotations,data/density_maps,data/images directories verified. No file payload downloaded.
shortlist.countCaveat: HF card claims1000train/200test, while GitHub directory illustration ends sample196train/sample38val and card layout also saystrain/val. Actual image file count/split not audited;196/38 must not be treated as verified actual counts.
shortlist.annotation: Per-object centre points, density maps, and up to6 exemplar boxes per image. Exemplar boxes are not full-instance detection boxes. XML annotations described by authors.

examples.publisherDescribes: Small/medium/large white and black screws/nuts, overlapping dense layouts often hundreds per image.

shortlist.fit: Most directly count-oriented industrial candidate; point-supervised/few-shot counting fits better than direct supervised YOLO boxes without additional annotation.
shortlist.productionPreference: Research-only/deferred source selection; publisher metadata declares noncommercial terms, with inconsistent card metadata. No user authorization request or training performed.

shortlist.name: MVTec Screws
shortlist.publicMetadataAccess: Official anonymous dataset/download pages accessed; published file link observed, archive not fetched.
shortlist.annotation: All objects annotated with oriented bounding boxes and category.

examples.publisherDescribes: Multiple loose screw/nut types on wooden background.

shortlist.fit: Real multi-object OBB counting/detection reference, unlike single-object SortScrews or surface-defect-only data. Not necessarily dense hundreds-per-scene coverage.
shortlist.productionPreference: Research comparison only; official source explicitly restricts commercial use. Not preferred as app training source.

shortlist.name: Rice-Variety-Classification-System-Dataset scene subset
shortlist.annotation: Manually annotated per-grain instance segmentation for YOLOv8; multiple grains on trays in controlled imaging chamber.
shortlist.publicMetadataAccess: Official landing page accessible without login and file/size publicly listed. Tried public API version URL returned404; actual archive retrieval not tested; no credential flow attempted.

examples.publisherDescribes: Approximately70 individually labelled rice grains per high-resolution tray photo, uniform background and lighting.

shortlist.fit: Use only407 original multi-grain segmentation images. The separate9000train+900val single-grain crop images are classification derivatives, not9900 independent counting scenes. Overlap/occlusion coverage still needs sample review.
shortlist.countTrainingReadiness: Promising geometry-labelled counting source, pending anonymous file and annotation verification.

shortlist.name: MEDISEG
shortlist.annotation: COCO per-instance segmentation polygons, bounding boxes and class labels;3-Pills and32-Pills core subsets.
shortlist.publicMetadataAccess: Official Figshare API anonymous200 with public files metadata; browser landing403 did not require/lead to account or workaround. No archive downloaded.

examples.publisherDescribes: Single and multiple pill photos, overlapping pills, cluttered dosette boxes, varied lighting/backgrounds.

shortlist.fit: Potential visible-object instance counting dataset. MEDISEG-Deploy is an evaluation/support/query extension; preserve declared partitions and do not silently turn query images into training.
shortlist.scope: Object counting research only; does not validate drug identification, dose decisions or clinical diagnosis.

excludedOrDifferentTask.name: GrainBench_Public
excludedOrDifferentTask.reason: 596 rice/bean photographs with verified integer totals (10–395), but no per-instance points/boxes/masks shown in inspected card; count-only benchmark is not interchangeable with localization ground truth.

excludedOrDifferentTask.name: GrainSet / GrainSpace
excludedOrDifferentTask.reason: Large single-kernel quality/classification collections; image count is not a crowded scene-count training count.

excludedOrDifferentTask.name: ePillID
excludedOrDifferentTask.reason: Fine-grained pill identification/reference images; not a cluttered many-pill instance counting dataset.

excludedOrDifferentTask.name: Kvasir Capsule
excludedOrDifferentTask.reason: Capsule-endoscopy frames of anatomical/pathological findings, not photographs of pills to count.

excludedOrDifferentTask.name: WEEE Disassembly Screw Dataset
excludedOrDifferentTask.reason: 945 images/4414 COCO screw instances, but mounted screw heads in devices (1–16/image), distinct from loose screw/nut piles; useful alternate mounted-fastener task, not used to inflate loose-pile coverage.
